_comment: Original lines written for this app - no quotations. One is shown per calendar day, chosen deterministically from the date (frontend/src/lib/motivation.ts), so a refresh never changes it. In the run-up to a countdown deadline (deadline_window_days) the line comes from 'deadline_season' instead, which is a little more encouraging. Add lines freely; keep them short, warm and specific to the work.
